review.title: Teaching turn review
review.subtitle: Read-only projection of post-turn review candidates. Human approval only — never auto-apply. Demo bundle, local decisions, or optional last durable snapshot (cache only; not settlement truth).
review.demoProjectDetail: Build a client-side sample bundle and call projectTeachingTurnReview to list candidates.
review.submitDecisionsDetail: Call decideTeachingTurnReview to re-project. Does not install skills or write memory.
review.empty: Post-turn review candidates require human approval and never auto-apply. Approved ids are display-only handoff hints for existing consent / skill / memory paths. Durable last-bundle is a rebuildable cache only — not settlement truth and never auto-applied.
review.advisoryNote: Never auto-apply — human approval only; approved ids are not an apply plan.
review.approvedIdsNote: These ids are not an apply plan. Downstream product paths must re-consent via skill-pack / memory / lesson flows.
review.apiUnavailable: teachingSystem review API is unavailable. Restart the app to load the latest preload.
review.handoffNote: Not an apply plan. These intents only describe which existing product consent surface may open later — never auto-apply, and this panel does not open real consent flows.
review.handoffUnmappedNote: Approved ids without a known handoff target. Display only — no execute path is implied.
review.loadLastDetail: Read the last saved review snapshot from app userData and project it. Durable cache only — never auto-apply.
review.saveLastDetail: Write the current local bundle (+ optional decisions) as the last durable snapshot. Demo/manual only — never auto-apply.
review.loadLastEmpty: No durable last-bundle snapshot is stored yet.
review.loadLastOk: Loaded durable snapshot ({{source}} · {{savedAt}}). Projected only — not applied.
review.saveLastOk: Saved current bundle as last durable snapshot (settings_demo). Not applied.
review.loadLastFailed: Failed to load last durable bundle
review.saveLastFailed: Failed to save last durable bundle

badPayload.detail: Internal communication data is malformed; refresh the page and try again.

windowControl.detail: This window action is unavailable on the current platform.

workspaceNotFound.detail: This workspace may have been moved or deleted; please re-import it.

invalidPath.detail: Please choose a valid folder as the teaching workspace.

emptyMission.detail: The learning mission can't be empty; briefly describe what you want to learn.

emptyTask.detail: Describe the lesson topic you want to generate in the input above.

pathRestricted.detail: Only files inside the teaching workspace are accessible.

fileNotFound.detail: The selected file may have been moved or deleted.

accessDenied.detail: No permission to access this file; check the file permissions.

agentToolLimit.detail: The conversation and planning context have been preserved. Send “generate the lesson” to retry, or raise the tool-call limit in Settings.

generic.detail: Please try again shortly. If the problem persists, contact support.
generic.stackDetail: The app hit an unexpected error. If it persists, restart the app.

errors.openAppData: Couldn't open the app data folder.

missionActionConflict.detail: This submit does not match the recorded action, or the workspace state changed. Reconfirm the mission and submit again as a new user action.

missionActionIndeterminate.detail: The previous mission update cannot be safely confirmed. Check the workspace, then reconfirm and submit again. Do not retry automatically.

directLessonActionConflict.detail: This submit does not match the recorded action ({{code}}), or the workspace state changed. Reconfirm and submit again as a new user action.

directLessonActionIndeterminate.detail: The previous lesson generation cannot be safely confirmed ({{code}}). Check the workspace, then reconfirm and submit again. Do not retry automatically.

directLessonActionRejected.detail: The request was rejected ({{code}}). Check the workspace and submit again as a new user action.

platformCapabilityDegraded.detail: This host is using a reduced I/O profile. Chat continues; durable writes may be unavailable or limited. This is not a model or network error.

emptyStream.detail: The provider returned no content. A bounded retry or fallback may apply. This is separate from platform capability limits.

memoryWriteUnavailable.detail: Durable memory write is unavailable or failed on this host profile. Nothing was silently marked as saved.

errorBoundary.fallbackDetail: The app hit an unexpected error; try reloading.
